description.zh:
要设置静态页面缓存的域名。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which you want to configure the Static Page Caching policy.

> You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all the domain names that are added to Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium.

description.zh:
是否开启OCSP功能。取值：
- **1**：开启
- **0**：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the OCSP feature. Valid values:

*   **1**: yes.
*   **0**: no.

title.zh: 设置是否启用 OCSP （Online Certificate Status Protocol）功能

descriptions.zh: 该功能适用于网站HTTPS业务。如果您已选择的协议类型包含HTTPS，推荐启用该功能。
descriptions.en: This feature is available only for a website that supports HTTPS. If HTTPS is selected for Protocol, we recommend that you enable this feature.
